primary_source_run.description: The original, UNMODIFIED 60-day M30-postfix replay used for all prior report sections (5/10/15/30/60-minute checkpoint data comes from this run's own real post-close learning telemetry, InpTradeBrainMemory=true and InpTradeBrainMonitorAfterExit=true, both confirmed active).

secondary_research_run.description: A separate, isolated telemetry-only build compiled to capture the one real checkpoint the original run's pipeline does not have: 20 minutes after close. Does NOT replace the primary run for anything except the 20-minute column.
secondary_research_run.ea_source_change: backend/ea_code/XAUUSD_AI_Sniper_EA.mq5: two new functions (XAU_BrainWatchClosedTrade20MinOnly, XAU_UpdateClosedTradeOutcomes20MinOnly) and one new array (g_brainClosedWatch20m[]), called from the same two real call sites as the existing 5/10/15/30/60m pipeline (XAU_BrainWatchClosedTrade's seeding call, and OnTick's per-tick update call). Verified NOT to call XAU_EVPostCloseReview, NOT to touch g_evExitLearningBias or g_exitBiasKeys (both read back live by XAU_EvaluateExitEV on later trades), and NOT to call XAU_AppendTradeBrain/XAU_AppendConsciousMemory (read back by lot-sizing). Uses the exact Bid-for-BUY/Ask-for-SELL executable-price convention requested for this analysis, not the existing pipeline's bid/ask midpoint.
secondary_research_run.tester_config: Identical to the primary run (same Login/Server/Symbol/Period/Model/FromDate/ToDate/Deposit/Leverage/ExpertParameters=v6255_m30.set) except Expert= points to this research build and Report= writes to a separate file so the original report is never overwritten.
secondary_research_run.reproduction_verification_status: NOT_OBTAINED -- the rerun itself never completed in this environment after multiple attempts (headless /config: launch did not reliably auto-start the Strategy Tester; see 60DAY_POST_EXIT_METHOD_AND_LIMITATIONS.md for the exact sequence of blockers encountered and the manual steps to complete it). 20-minute columns in the CSVs/HTML report are genuinely empty, not estimated.
secondary_research_run.ea_source_reverted: backend/ea_code/XAUUSD_AI_Sniper_EA.mq5 and the root-copy XAUUSD_AI_Sniper_EA.mq5 were reverted to the clean pre-patch production state (SHA-256 f0e7058cb2347bbcb6a9cda552cf52be2a14ff73fc3f076ad35bdeca0eae6575, matching the committed v6.25.6 release) after the rerun attempts were abandoned, so the committed production source carries no research-only code. The exact patch used for the compiled research EX5 above is preserved at audits/gold_learning/60day_behavior_report/research_patches/20min_post_close_telemetry_only.patch for full reproducibility.

r_conversion_method: Each position's own risk_usd (from 60DAY_ALL_POSITIONS.csv, the EA's own structural risk in dollars, computed once at entry) is used as the 1R denominator. The EA's post-close checkpoint tracker already reports maxMore/maxReverse as dollar amounts for the same position (missedMoney/avoidedMoney), so MISSED_R = missedMoney / risk_usd directly -- no ATR-to-price-to-R chained conversion, no candle-OHLC estimation.
